The New Museum presents ''New Humans: Memories of the Future,'' an exhibition exploring what it means to be human amid technological change, featuring more than 150 international artists, writers, scientists, architects, and filmmakers, with over 700 works. The museum begins with this exhibition following the New Museum's 60,000-square-foot building expansion, which cost $82 million. (Photo by Matthew Hoen/NurPhoto)
